improvementAreas.name: Optimize Images
improvementAreas.description: Compress and resize images to reduce page load times.

improvementAreas.name: Minify CSS & JavaScript
improvementAreas.description: Remove unnecessary characters from CSS and JS files.

improvementAreas.name: Enable Browser Caching
improvementAreas.description: Allow browsers to store static assets locally for faster subsequent loads.

improvementAreas.name: Reduce HTTP Requests
improvementAreas.description: Combine files and use sprites to minimize the number of requests.

improvementAreas.name: Lazy Load Images
improvementAreas.description: Load images only when they are visible in the viewport.

improvementAreas.name: Use a Content Delivery Network (CDN)
improvementAreas.description: Serve static assets from servers geographically closer to users.

improvementAreas.name: Optimize Font Loading
improvementAreas.description: Use modern font formats and preload critical fonts.

improvementAreas.name: Implement Server-Side Rendering (SSR)
improvementAreas.description: Render initial HTML on the server for faster perceived load times.

features.name: Dark Mode
features.description: Enable a dark theme for the application.

features.name: Smooth Animations
features.description: Enable subtle animations for UI elements.

features.name: Real-time Data Updates
features.description: Show live updates for performance metrics.
